en: Color-printed vintage postcard showing a picturesque courtyard scene with old half-timbered and masonry houses with red-tiled roofs, a large leafy tree in the foreground, and several children standing behind a low picket fence. In the distant background two ornate church or cathedral towers rise above the roofs. At the top center is a printed German caption, and a handwritten number appears in red ink in the upper right corner.
